passage:
The city art center held a drawing contest with a new rule: students could use AI tools, but they had to explain how they used them.
Some students typed one sentence and printed the first picture they got. Others used AI only to test ideas before drawing by hand. One student used AI to create five versions of a city at night, then combined the best parts into her own painting.
The judges did not choose the most colorful picture. They chose the work that showed the clearest human decision.
After the contest, the art center wrote on its wall: "A tool can help create, but it cannot care. The artist must still choose what matters."
